Definition: from a derivative of G4521; a "sabbatism", i.e. (figuratively) the repose of Christianity (as a type of heaven):--rest.
BiblicalUsage: Read sabbatismós as a "sabbatism", that is (figuratively) the repose of Christianity (as a type of heaven). It stands in Hebrews 4:9: "There remaineth therefore a rest to the people…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that sabbatismós counts, because God put it in his book.
